answer: Histories are stored in comet, checked in delta, and whisper reveals each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 1 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 2187 identities would post 2905 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
